title: Sync fixes, round 2 — the two changes you asked for

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when sync failed for a reason other than GitHub sign-in
steps.headline: Try again sits at the right on the Show details line, and Connect GitHub is gone here.
steps.changed: Show details and Try again now share one line. Connect GitHub no longer appears, because this failure has nothing to do with signing in.
steps.notice: One clear button for this kind of failure. Opening Show details drops the text below without moving the button.
steps.risk: If you really are signed out but the error doesn't say so, you'd reconnect from the GitHub row instead.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when your GitHub sign-in has expired
steps.headline: When sign-in is the problem, Connect GitHub sits just left of Try again, on the same line.
steps.changed: Connect GitHub (outlined) now sits left of Try again (dark), both on the Show details line.
steps.notice: The message itself says to reconnect, and the button for it is right there.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when a conversation is too big to sync
steps.headline: Too-big conversations now show in the app's standard orange warning card, names always visible.
steps.changed: The bare orange dropdown became the same warning card used elsewhere in the app, titled Too big to sync, with the conversation names listed inside.
steps.notice: No click needed to see which conversations are affected.
steps.risk: The card makes the sync box taller while any conversation is over the limit.
